title: Argument Evaluation: Logical Fallacies & Evidence Strength
goal: Name six common logical fallacies and spot them in a real-feeling argument; rank evidence from strong to weak inside one essay.

questions: Find the sentence that commits an ad hominem — it attacks people rather than their argument. Quote it.
Find the sentence that commits a straw man — it exaggerates the opposing position before knocking it down. Quote it.
Find the passage that commits a slippery slope — a chain of increasingly extreme consequences asserted without evidence for each step. Quote it.
